text: Offline specialist order is sequential; failures and contradictions are visible outcomes.

Source: C:/Users/HET/Downloads/ProjectForge_UML_Sequence_Diagrams_A4.pdf, page 2. Rebuilt as editable native shapes. Analyze saves state, schedules a background coroutine, then returns started. Offline agents run Product, AI/ML, Engineering, UX, Security, QA. Validation failures or conflicts stop progress. SSE is an independent API stream that reads persistent events. PIPELINE_COMPLETED means planning returned normally; current code may still mark the specification BLOCKED.

Source: C:/Users/HET/Downloads/ProjectForge_UML_Sequence_Diagrams_A4.pdf, page 3. Rebuilt as editable native shapes. The API waits for shield(worker), even though execution uses a thread.
